steps.title: Make fences
steps.say: Craft [fences](item:oak_fence) from 4 [planks](item:oak_planks) and 2 [sticks](item:stick). Each craft makes 3 fences.

steps.title: Build the square
steps.say: Pick a flat grassy spot. Put [fences](item:oak_fence) in a square, and use the gate as one of the sides.

steps.title: Light it up
steps.say: Put [torches](item:torch) on the [fence](item:oak_fence) posts so monsters can not spawn inside.

steps.title: Bring animals in
steps.say: Hold their food and they follow you. Walk them through the gate, then close it behind you.

steps.title: Or use a lead
steps.say: Use a [lead](item:lead) on an animal to walk it like a dog. Tie the lead to a [fence](item:oak_fence) post to keep it there.
